What I changed in Change Stack

CodeRabbit Change Stack · Formbricks #8650 · Parth Pawar

I wanted to keep the file, explanation, and review progress connected. I kept file-by-file review and changed how you move between those things.

What got in the wayWhat I changed
The layer, file path, and file position are spread across the screen.I kept the layer, file, and path together. Previous and Next switch files directly; the position opens the searchable nine-file list. Each file keeps its reading position.
Several rows of file controls compete with the diff.I put frequent file actions in one toolbar and kept Submit review in the PR header. I preserved J/K and Z. Wrap is visible beside the diff and on by default.
The 37-summary count belongs to the layer. access.ts has six.The tab shows file summaries. Layer activity holds the layer count and seen progress. The two access.ts summaries have manually mapped code anchors; other summaries open at their start. The full source summary stays available.
Seen summaries, viewed files, and a submitted review mean different things.PR progress stays in the header; the seven-file demo boundary stays in the footer. Opening a file never marks it viewed. Viewed changes have Undo. Summary seen and the final decision remain separate.

Keep long lines readable

Unified and Split wrap by default at 13 px, with a visible Wrap toggle. Wrapping adds vertical scrolling. Split gives added code more room with a 96 px empty Before rail; Equal panes restores 50/50.

What I checked

The comparison keeps the same imports, full source summary, and captured progress. I checked wrapping, anchor jumps, file switching, Undo and keyboard access at 1440 and 1280 px. These are implementation checks; developer testing remains outstanding.

What I’d test next

I’d test whether developers can explain the code behind each anchor and comfortably read long lines. Modified-file diffs and cross-file review need further work. Supporting states and explorations are optional.

This uses the out-of-date Formbricks #8650 snapshot at 23cdac2. Seven of 52 diffs are included. Other content is labeled as a preview; not every source workflow is implemented. Submitting a review is simulated and sends nothing.
